report_name: Qilin Ransomware Claims Attacks on Multiple Firms Across Sectors

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: A Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) group that operates a double-extortion model, claiming attacks on multiple organizations and listing them on its dark web leak site to pressure them into paying a ransom. The group has shown a high operational tempo and an industry-agnostic approach to targeting.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: As part of its double-extortion model, the Qilin ransomware group deploys its payload to encrypt systems on the victim's network.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin ransomware group exfiltrates large volumes of sensitive data to cloud storage services before encrypting victim networks, using the stolen data as leverage in their double-extortion scheme.

malware.name: Qilin
malware.description: A highly configurable ransomware written in Go, used by the Qilin group and its affiliates to encrypt victim systems. It is a key component of their double-extortion attacks.

tools.name: Rclone
tools.description: A common tool used by ransomware groups like Qilin to exfiltrate data to cloud storage as part of the double-extortion model.

identities.name: Hawaii Family Dental
identities.description: A U.S.-based healthcare provider listed as a victim on the Qilin ransomware group's dark web leak site on July 31, 2026. The group claimed to have stolen internal files.

identities.name: ADPO
identities.description: A logistics and chemical company based in Belgium, listed as a victim on the Qilin ransomware group's dark web leak site.

identities.name: Audio Precision, Inc.
identities.description: A U.S.-based technology company listed as a victim on the Qilin ransomware group's dark web leak site.

identities.name: Byonyks
identities.description: A U.S.-based medical device company listed as a victim on the Qilin ransomware group's dark web leak site.

identities.name: DB Tarımsal Enerji
identities.description: An energy company based in Turkey, listed as a victim on the Qilin ransomware group's dark web leak site.

identities.name: Affinity Capital
identities.description: A financial services company based in the Philippines, listed as a victim on the Qilin ransomware group's dark web leak site.

infrastructure.name: Qilin dark web leak site
infrastructure.description: The dark web site used by the Qilin ransomware group to publish the names of their victims and threaten the release of exfiltrated data as part of their double-extortion strategy.

indicators.name: SAM Database Dump via reg.exe
indicators.pattern:
title: SAM Database Dump via reg.exe
id: 2b8c1a9f-4e8d-4f6a-8b1c-9d0e1f2a3b4c
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of reg.exe to save a copy of the SAM hive, a common technique for offline credential harvesting used by ransomware groups.
references:
  - https://www.galaxywarden.com/blog/breach/hawaii-family-dental-qilin-2026-07
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-31
tags:
  - attack.t1003.002
  - attack.credential_access
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\reg.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'save'
      - 'hklm\sam'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects command line activity related to dumping the SAM database for credential harvesting, a precursor activity for ransomware attacks like Qilin's.

indicators.name: Rclone Execution for Data Exfiltration
indicators.pattern:
title: Rclone Execution for Data Exfiltration
id: 5d9e8f7a-6b5c-4d3e-2a1b-0c9d8e7f6a5b
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of rclone.exe, a tool commonly used by ransomware groups to exfiltrate data to cloud storage providers.
references:
  - https://www.galaxywarden.com/blog/breach/hawaii-family-dental-qilin-2026-07
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-31
tags:
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.exfiltration
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\rclone.exe'
  selection_orig:
    OriginalFileName: 'rclone.exe'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects the execution of rclone.exe, a tool frequently used by ransomware groups such as Qilin for data exfiltration prior to encryption.
